From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: [Production] Sudden p99 spikes across endpoints — Oliva Retail

Kim / team — quick triage:
- Observed a sharp uptick in KV prefix miss ratio at ~08:43 PT across the hosted-us-west pool serving Oliva. Miss ratio climbed from ~1.8% to ~14% for Oliva's prefixes.
- Concurrent global soft-eviction sweeps were executed by the background TTL compaction job in the cluster (job id: compaction-2113). Evidence: eviction markers and overlapping flush windows in region logs.
- The combination produced high backend fetch fanout for cold prefixes — a classic "cache-ghost" amplification: multiple requests trigger backend fetches for the same prefix after a near-simultaneous eviction.

Short-term mitigation candidates (ranked):
1) Pause global prefix eviction for the Oliva serving shard and rehydrate hot prefixes from snapshot cache.
2) Ramp TTL for Oliva prefixes from 5m -> 20m to reduce churn.
3) Apply per-customer jitter on eviction timing to avoid synchronized holes.

I can start pause (#1) immediately if Marcus gives the go-ahead and we have agreement from Kim to notify the customer. Will attach perf logs once I slice them.

-Jonas
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
[Attachment: kv_stats_11-10.csv (csv, 160KB)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: [Production] Sudden p99 spikes across endpoints — Oliva Retail

Confirming Jonas' findings. Attached are sliced traces and a quick log excerpt — you can see the miss storms and the concurrent compaction task start times.

Excerpt:
[2026-11-10T08:42:59Z] compaction-2113 START shard=us-west target-prefix=oliva_
[2026-11-10T08:43:04Z] prefix-miss ratio[oliva_]/window(60s)=13.9%
[2026-11-10T08:43:05Z] backend-fanout[oliva_prefix_92]=17
[2026-11-10T08:43:06Z] streaming-error-rate=2.1%

Mitigation applied at 09:05 PT: paused compaction-2113 for Oliva shard, promoted last-good snapshot to warm cache, and bumped TTL to 18m for oliva prefixes. Initial telemetry shows p99 falling back toward baseline and error rate down to 0.4% in the 10-min window after mitigation.

Recommended follow-ups (next 24h):
- Run post-mortem to adjust compaction jitter and add guard rails to prevent global sweeps from hitting single-tenant hotsets.
- Add an auto-safeguard: if miss ratio for a prefix rises >8% in a 1-min window, abort global eviction for that customer for 30m.

Attachments: perf_logs_20261110.zip (contains traces & perf counters).

-Marcus
SRE Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: perf_logs_20261110.zip (zip, 3.2MB)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Jorge Ramos <jorge@olivaretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: [Production] Sudden p99 spikes across endpoints — Oliva Retail

Jorge —

Thanks for the quick heads-up and the HAR. First, I want to apologize for the disruption during your promotion prep window. Marcus and Jonas identified a burst of prefix eviction activity that coincided with your cache refresh — that produced what our eng team calls a "cache-ghost" amplification where many requests simultaneously miss and fetch from backend.

What we did (already active):
- Paused the compaction sweep for your shard.
- Promoted the last-good snapshot into the warm cache and increased your prefix TTL to 18m.
- Monitoring continues; p99 and error rates improved in the immediate window.

Next steps we'd like to take with your approval (non-disruptive first):
1) Keep the eviction paused for 24 hours while we gather RCA data.
2) Run a controlled TTL ramp test off-peak (we'll coordinate timing).
3) Prepare a written RCA and a remediation plan including a fix to compaction jitter.

As a gesture, we'll apply a minor credit for the impacted hour and commit to a 4-week follow-up with telemetry and the RCA. Please let me know if you approve the 24h pause and the credit.

Sincerely,
Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: customer_comm_oliva_11-10.docx (docx, 28KB)]
